b11.balai: Datang ke balai desa dan ikut daftar pencarian
b11.daftar: Nama sudah tercatat, ikuti rapat warga

ibu.1: Nak, kenal Joy? Anak saya penjaga ladang di ujung sana.
ibu.2: Kenal, Bu. Sedikit. Dia pernah menyapa saya di jalan.
ibu.3: Tiga hari dia tidak menelepon. Padahal tiap pagi dia selalu.

a.1: Ibu itu mengangguk. Matanya merah, tapi tidak menangis.
a.2: Terima kasih. Cari di hutan ya, jangan di kampung.

b.1: Kata-kataku terdengar kecil bahkan untukku sendiri.

laporan.1: Meja balai penuh kertas. Satu di antaranya laporan kehilangan atas nama Joy.
laporan.2: Ada foto diselipkan. Joy tersenyum, memakai kalung bulan sabit.
laporan.3: Aku tidak tahu kenapa detail itu melekat. Tanpa sadar aku mengingatnya.

teman.1: Raka! Kapan balik? Katanya kuliahmu sibuk.
teman.2: Dengar soal ladang itu? Orang jaga hilang, api lagi.

api.1: Bulan ini tiga kali. Warga bilang kering, tapi polanya aneh.
api.2: Jamnya selalu malam. Kalau kering, siang lebih mudah terjadi.

joy.1: Joy? Diam-diam orangnya. Suka bernyanyi pelan kalau lewat.
joy.2: Ibunya tadi ke balai, bawa foto.

biasa.1: Pokoknya mampir ke kedai. Kopinya masih sama seperti dulu.

daftar.1: Kotak pensil dan daftar pencarian warga. Nama ditulis berurutan.
daftar.2: Aku menulis namaku di baris terakhir.

kumpul.1: Titik api ketiga semalam. Besok kita bagi regu.
kumpul.2: Aku memegang kertas catatan tanggal di saku.
kumpul.3: Tiga kejadian, satu arah. Kalau diam, tidak ada yang mengecek.

a.1: Pak, titiknya berurutan. Menurut saya ini bukan kebetulan.
a.2: Jangan bikin panik. Tapi catat itu, nak. Kita lihat besok.
a.3: Kata-kataku sudah keluar. Tidak bisa ditarik lagi.

b.2: Besok mungkin lebih banyak bukti. Mungkin.

tangan.1: Abang lewat depan balai, tangan kanannya terbalut kain.
tangan.2: Kainnya baru. Ujungnya ada bekas hangus kecil.
tangan.3: Aku mau bertanya, tapi dia sudah masuk warung.

baju.1: Abang lewat depan balai, bahu bajunya robek.

none.1: Abang lewat depan balai tanpa berhenti.
none.2: Kami hanya melambai. Ada yang berubah di matanya.

pintu.1: Aku keluar dari balai. Jalan desa terang, tapi rasanya gelap.
pintu.2: Di saku ada satu nama yang belum selesai: Joy.

b11.balai: Go to the village hall and join the search list
b11.daftar: Your name is on the list, join the villagers' meeting

ibu.1: Do you know Joy, dear? My daughter looks after the field at the far end.
ibu.2: I know her, Ma'am. A little. She once greeted me on the road.
ibu.3: Three days and she has not called. She calls every morning.
ibu.cA: I will help look for her, Ma'am.
ibu.cB: I am sorry to hear that, Ma'am.

a.1: She nods. Her eyes are red, but she does not cry.
a.2: Thank you. Look in the forest, not in the village.

b.1: My words sound small even to me.

laporan.1: The hall table is covered in papers. One is a missing person report for Joy.
laporan.2: A photo is tucked in. Joy smiles, wearing a crescent moon necklace.
laporan.3: I do not know why that detail sticks. I remember it without meaning to.

teman.1: Raka! When did you get back? They say your studies keep you busy.
teman.2: Heard about that field? The caretaker is gone, and fire again.
teman.3: Which one do you want to hear first?

api.1: Three times this month. People say it is dry, but the pattern is odd.
api.2: It is always night. If it were dry weather, daytime would be more likely.

joy.1: Joy? She kept to herself. She liked humming softly when she passed.
joy.2: Her mother came to the hall earlier, with a photo.

biasa.1: Anyway, stop by the cafe. The coffee is the same as always.

daftar.1: A pencil box and the residents' search list. Names written in order.
daftar.2: I write my name on the last line.

kumpul.1: The third fire point last night. Tomorrow we split into teams.
kumpul.2: I hold the paper with the dates in my pocket.
kumpul.3: Three incidents, one direction. If I stay quiet, no one checks.

a.1: Sir, the points follow a sequence. I do not think it is coincidence.
a.2: Do not cause a panic. But write that down, son. We will see tomorrow.
a.3: My words are out. I cannot take them back.

b.1: I pull my hand away from the paper.
b.2: Tomorrow there may be more evidence. Maybe.

tangan.1: Abang passes the hall, his right hand wrapped in cloth.
tangan.2: The cloth is new. There is a small burn mark at the edge.
tangan.3: I want to ask, but he has already entered the shop.

baju.1: Abang passes the hall, the shoulder of his shirt torn.
baju.2: He looks down when he sees me.

none.1: Abang passes the hall without stopping.
none.2: We only wave. Something has changed in his eyes.

pintu.1: I step out of the hall. The village road is bright, but it feels dark.
pintu.2: In my pocket there is one unfinished name: Joy.
